package telegram

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

type DeliveryWorker struct {
	Store          repository.TelegramDeliveryStore
	Sender         repository.TelegramSender
	Tokens         TokenGenerator
	Clock          Clock
	LeaseTTL       time.Duration
	RetryBaseDelay time.Duration
	RetryMaxDelay  time.Duration
}

func (worker DeliveryWorker) ProcessNext(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
	if worker.Store == nil || worker.Sender == nil || worker.Tokens == nil || worker.Clock == nil || worker.LeaseTTL <= 0 ||
		worker.RetryBaseDelay <= 0 || worker.RetryMaxDelay < worker.RetryBaseDelay {
		return false, domain.ErrTelegramUnavailable
	}
	now := worker.Clock.Now().UTC()
	claimToken := worker.Tokens.NewID()
	delivery, claimed, err := worker.Store.ClaimDelivery(ctx, claimToken, now, now.Add(worker.LeaseTTL))
	if err != nil || !claimed {
		return claimed, err
	}
	remoteID, err := worker.Sender.SendText(ctx, delivery.ChatID, delivery.Body)
	if err == nil {
		return true, worker.Store.MarkDeliverySent(ctx, delivery.SourceMessageID, claimToken, remoteID, worker.Clock.Now().UTC())
	}
	code := "telegram_send_failed"
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTelegramRejected) {
		stateErr := worker.Store.BlockDelivery(ctx, delivery.SourceMessageID, claimToken, "telegram_rejected", worker.Clock.Now().UTC())
		return true, errors.Join(err, stateErr)
	}
	retryAt := now.Add(worker.retryDelay(delivery.Attempts))
	stateErr := worker.Store.RetryDelivery(ctx, delivery.SourceMessageID, claimToken, code, retryAt, worker.Clock.Now().UTC())
	return true, errors.Join(err, stateErr)
}

func (worker DeliveryWorker) retryDelay(attempt int) time.Duration {
	if attempt < 1 {
		attempt = 1
	}
	delay := worker.RetryBaseDelay
	for current := 1; current < attempt && delay < worker.RetryMaxDelay; current++ {
		if delay > worker.RetryMaxDelay/2 {
			return worker.RetryMaxDelay
		}
		delay *= 2
	}
	if delay > worker.RetryMaxDelay {
		return worker.RetryMaxDelay
	}
	return delay
}

func ValidateDeliveryBody(body string) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(body) == "" || len(body) > 48000 {
		return domain.ErrTelegramUnavailable
	}
	return nil
}
